description: This tool gets one doctor's public record by 10-digit NPI. The record lists offices, specialties, and affiliated hospitals. It lists hospital results for each procedure that has them. It lists federal exclusion-list checks, state medical board actions matched by license number in states OpenHealth covers, and published procedure counts and outcome measures with their sources. A hospital result describes a hospital, not the doctor. OpenHealth gives doctors no grade or score. The counts and measures are Medicare records only, so they are incomplete.
name: get_doctor
title: Get a doctor's public record
